endpoints.screen: Invite team member (business-owner app, Team tab "+")
endpoints.description: Post-publish equivalent of business-setup.json#invite-team-member (onboarding's Team invite step), but collects the fuller field set that step never asked for: name, commission split, and working days. At least one of email/phone is required. An invitation IS the team roster record — there's no separate 'member' entity — so this returns the same shape list-my-invitations/get-business-profile-style team lists would use.

errors.message: This email or phone already has a pending invitation

endpoints.description: Edits a team member's commission split and/or working days. Works the same whether the member's invitation is still pending or already accepted — no separate 'accepted member' record exists to edit instead.
